title: Notes from a Literature Log
text:
Many readers keep a literature log to record the short stories they finish. In her log, Elif writes the title, the author, and a short comment about the ending. Last month she read a story about a lighthouse keeper who receives a letter from a stranger. The story left her thinking about loneliness for several days.

Her favourite entry is about a story with almost no dialogue. The author uses small details, such as a cup of cold tea on the table, to show the character's feelings. Elif says that these details made her slow down and read more carefully. She now plans to write a longer review that compares three of the stories she has read this year.

questions.text: What does Elif write in her literature log?
options: The title, the author, and a short comment about the ending

questions.text: What does the author use to show the character's feelings in Elif's favourite story?
options: Small details, such as a cup of cold tea

questions.text: Why did Elif read her favourite story more carefully?
options: She found the story boring and wanted to finish it
She had to read it for a school exam
The small details encouraged her to slow down
The lighthouse keeper was her favourite character

questions.text: What can be inferred about Elif's attitude toward short stories?
options: She thinks short stories deserve careful and detailed analysis
She finds short stories too simple to enjoy
She has stopped keeping her literature log
She prefers novels to short stories

paragraph_translations: Birçok okur, bitirdikleri kısa öyküleri kaydetmek için bir edebiyat günlüğü tutar. Elif günlüğüne başlığı, yazarı ve sondan bahseden kısa bir yorum yazar. Geçen ay bir deniz feneri bekçisinin yabancı biri tarafından yazılmış bir mektup aldığı bir öykü okudu. Öykü, birkaç gün boyunca yalnızlık hakkında düşünmesine neden oldu.

En sevdiği kayıt, neredeyse hiç diyalog içermeyen bir öyküyle ilgili. Yazar, karakterin duygularını göstermek için soğumuş bir bardak çay gibi küçük ayrıntılar kullanır. Elif, bu ayrıntıların onu yavaşlamaya ve daha dikkatli okumaya yönlendirdiğini söylüyor. Şimdi bu yıl okuduğu üç öyküyü karşılaştıran daha uzun bir eleştiri yazmayı planlıyor.
